definitions.full: H15. abeh [ בַּי בָּיַי, ] verb entreat (Arabic come as suppliant, entreat , still current in the Hauran: see Wetzst in De Job 34:36 ), of which (probably) אָבִי 34:36 is 1 singular imperfect (used dialectically): אִיּוֺב יִבְּחֵן אָבִי would that (literally I entreat that ) Job were tried!

occurrences.englishText: I wish that Job were tried to the end,
